criteria.description: Review file_drills.py: text overwrite/append/read (5), JSON string round trip (5), CSV quoting and numeric conversion (5).
Demonstrate menu, empty listing, nonblank names, valid prices/stocks, and unique IDs after restart.
Demonstrate totals and all rejected-sale cases; stock must remain unchanged on rejection.
Validate record types, required fields, ranges, and unique IDs.
Missing file returns []; bad syntax/structure/encoding/read errors are preserved and raised.
Save/load round trip, replacement, invalid-data protection, and failed-write preservation.
Demonstrate restart persistence, startup refusal on bad data, and in-memory consistency after a failed save.
Export exact columns, quoted names, extra-field selection, and an empty header.
Review demo.md explanations and verify failed export never reports success.
